name: element.update
title: Update element
summary: Change title, text or properties of one element. Unknown properties are kept, and unset removes one (#189); status changes only via element.setStatus, and the origin of an imported element only via reqif.import (SR-057).
whileReadOnlyReason: Changes an element file, and no change can be checked against a missing or faulty metamodel.

text.description: New Markdown text of the element; the blank line after the closing `---` is not part of the text, so the text element.get gives can be passed back unchanged. A changed text gets a final line break (ADR-0004). Another element is named by a Markdown link, `[Title](reqseq:N-6010df)` with its UUID, short ID or identifier, which is written as UUID and version; `reqseq:N-6010df` alone is no link and counts for nothing.

setItems.description: List items by position from 1: 1..n replace, n+1.. append; other items keep their bytes, but each acceptance criterion is written with its key (SR-204).

addRelations.description: Relations to add by kind, as relation.add adds them, in the same write (#175). A relation the element has with a valid version is kept.

removeRelations.description: Relations to remove by kind, as relation.remove removes them (a UUID as given), in the same write (#175). Nothing to remove is an info problem relation.not-found.

repository.description: Which of the elements ref names is meant: its repository's workspace name. ref.ambiguous and ref.unknown (none of them in it) list them in details.candidates.

expectedFileSha256.description: Write precondition (SR-166): the fileSha256 the change was made on (element.get). Required with title, text or setItems, else input.invalid (precondition-missing); optional for set, unset and relations alone. Other bytes now: file.changed-on-disk, nothing written, even for no change.

dryRun.description: Dry run: checks and output, no write (SR-246).

names.title: Named elements
names.description: The elements the element names by UUID only, each once in the order first named: the variants of `validity` and the views and missing children of `verification`, as element.get names them (#1216). Left out when it names none.

fileSha256.title: File SHA-256
fileSha256.description: Of the file as written, or as read when nothing changed or in a dry run (SR-166, SR-246 AK5).

files.title: Files
files.description: Written files, relative to the workspace root; empty in a dry run.

dryRun.title: Dry run
dryRun.description: In a dry run (SR-246): nothing written.

filesToWrite.title: Files to write
filesToWrite.description: Only in a dry run: the file an update would write, relative to the workspace root; empty when nothing would change.

affected.title: Affected elements
affected.description: The number of directly affected elements (SR-024 AK2): the distinct elements other than this one whose files hold a relation or an inline reference to it, the elements at distance 1 of `trace.affected`. Counted only when the save changed what the version is computed from in normal form n1 or n2 (the content, D-013, ADR-0005), so also when it changed only the stored version of a reference: a link that stores n1 of this element becomes outdated by it; 0 when only the title or properties that do not count to the version changed, or nothing changed (SR-024 AK3). For an element without a version (a value that counts has no normal form, ADR-0005) what the version is computed from is compared, so a save of only its title or status also gives 0 (ThomasBirkmaier/ReqSeq-archive#276).

affectedElements.title: Affected elements
affectedElements.description: The elements `affected` counts, in store order; empty when it is 0.
